pc.notes: Tunnel Bore, The Listener, and Hovercraft are built in now too -- six built-in add-ons in all, in three half-button rows under Built-in add-ons. Tree Chopper, Better Fishing, and Ember Graves carry their newest pack builds inside (their settings items are craftable in survival now). "Check for new mods" knows all six are built in.

phone.notes: Three new built-in add-ons, and fresher packs inside. New buttons under Built-in add-ons: Tunnel Bore -- a rideable mining machine you build in two parts (a Bore Body plus a clip-on Drill Tip) that chews a 3x3 tunnel while you sit in it, burning coal as it goes; The Listener -- a tall pale thing that stalks the dark and only moves while nobody is looking at it; and Hovercraft -- a steerable rideable hovercraft that glides over land AND water. Tree Chopper, Better Fishing, and Ember Graves also carry their newest pack builds, and their settings items can now be crafted in survival. The app itself works exactly like 1.7.
